kicker: Mobile Engineer — Buenos Aires, remote worldwide
headlineEmphasis: to the one nobody thought would ship again.
subhead: Five+ years building mobile products in React Native and Kotlin — some from a blank screen, some inherited mid-crisis. I built El Puma Contigo from scratch with an AI-assisted workflow baked in from day one. I took over Techint's internal app after a year with no releases and shipped three in three months. Same instincts either way: tests before changes, structure before features, and enough client communication that the roadmap stays honest.
